title: Explicit uncurrying equivalence on ordinary cochains
statement: Let X be a scheme and P,L,I integer-indexed complexes of O_X-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. For each k the constructed normalizedTensorHomCochains is an additive equivalence from ordinary k-cochains P to Hom(L,I) [def-pur-hom-complex] to k-cochains Tot(P tensor L) to I [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. It is the inverse normalized global comparison, followed by postcomposition with homTensorDegreewiseMap [lem-sc-hom-tensor-degreewise], followed by the output normalized global comparison [lem-pc-normalized-hom-complex-global-cochains]. It commutes with the differential in every pair of degrees. No homotopy-category statement or component normalization is claimed here.

source.place: Tag 0A90 (lemma-compose), with the global comparison of Tag 0A8Z

proof.text: Compose the inverse normalized global-cochain equivalence, postcomposition by the degreewise isomorphism, and the output normalized global-cochain equivalence. Postcomposition by the inverse isomorphism is its additive inverse.

Transport the differential through the inverse input comparison by injectivity of the forward comparison. Then use the degreewise differential equation and the output comparison differential equation.

theorem normalizedTensorHomCochains_comm (X : Scheme.{u})
    (P L I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (k m : ℤ) (c : Cochain P (homComplex (R := X.sheaf) L I) k) :
    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory X.sheaf
    normalizedTensorHomCochains X P L I m (δ k m c) =
      δ k m (normalizedTensorHomCochains X P L I k c)
